description: RENDERS an AI Video Story episode into its final delivered file (stage 3 of 3), after the scene videos are done. It is composed SERVER-side from the stored episode (scenes, captions, music, title card, watermark policy); you pass only the episode id. WHEN: `get_video` shows `succeeded` or `story.stage: "ready_to_render"` (an episode edited in the web editor renders with those edits; a later render replaces the file). AFTER: the answer carries `render_id` and `story.stage: "rendering"`. Wait with `wait_for_generation` or read `get_video`: `stage: "rendered"` means `story.render.url` is the FINAL file, and THAT is the url to give the user with one line (its length) and one clause that captions and deeper edits live in the aicut web editor. `story.render.status: "failed"` means it failed and was refunded: ask before rendering again. NEVER hand out the episode url before `rendered`: at `ready_to_render` it is only the raw stitched preview. A repeat during a render answers the SAME `render_id` with `coalesced: true`: not a failure. COST: per rendered minute at the platform render rate, from the episode's own duration. `estimate_only: true` works only once the episode is renderable (before then it refuses and names the stage); earlier, give `pricing.render_tokens_per_minute` (series' full `list_series` entry) as a rate or a tilde figure, never as the price. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: a render is its own charge and ask; approving the scene videos or saying the episode looks good is not a go to render. The user must name rendering or the final file, and a bare 'yes' counts only as the direct answer to your priced render ask. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).
name: render_story_video
title: Render a story episode (the final file)
